scope: PaySim sequence loader/materialization validation only; no model training or performance results
split_strategy: whole-step chronological split: train 1-281, validation 282-355, test 356-743

representation.time: step; strict history condition history_step < target_step
representation.target: isFraud, stored separately from input features
excluded_features: nameOrig (not the selected entity; excluded from features)
nameDest (entity key only; not a model feature)
representation.truncation: retain newest whole buckets; never split a tied step
representation.within_step_order: unordered event set serialized by transaction type, amount, then source row for exact ties; no temporal interpretation
representation.padding_and_masking: no padding in examples; ragged tuples; a future batch collator can pad and derive masks
representation.ordering: target step ascending; history buckets chronological; deterministic source-order tie resolution

materialization.reproducibility: pinned archive hash, Phase 10 contract, fixed schema/splits/cap, and deterministic ordering
